description: This file is a Java test class for the PatientEditor component within the OpenMRS project. It contains test setup for editing Patient objects, utilizing dependency injection for PatientService, and defines test methods for obtaining new editor instances and fetching existing Patient objects.

classes.name: PatientEditorTest
classes.description: Test class for PatientEditor, extending BasePropertyEditorTest with Patient as the entity type and PatientEditor as the editor.

methods.name: getNewEditor
methods.description: Returns a new instance of PatientEditor for testing.

methods.name: getExistingObject
methods.description: Retrieves an existing Patient object with ID 2 from PatientService.
